title: Enrichment Configuration Guide for Palo Alto Networks WildFire

blocks.text: This configuration guide provides information on prerequisites and how to integrate Zscaler ITDR with Palo Alto Networks WildFire.
Before you configure enrichment integration, ensure that you have:

blocks.item: An active Palo Alto Networks WildFire account.
The Palo Alto Networks WildFire console URL.
Obtained the Palo Alto Networks WildFire API key. In the Palo Alto Networks WildFire console, go to My Account and copy the API key.

blocks.heading: Configuring Enrichment Integration with Palo Alto Networks WildFire

blocks.text: To configure enrichment integration with Palo Alto Networks WildFire:

blocks.item: Locate Palo Alto Networks WildFire in the table, and click the Edit icon under the Actions column.
In the Palo Alto Networks WildFire window:
Enter the URL of the Palo Alto Networks WildFire console.
Enrichment integration with Palo Alto Networks WildFire is enabled.
